en: Tinted vintage postcard showing a tranquil canal or lake bordered by trees and grassy banks. In the foreground several swans, both white and black, glide on the water. To the right, a man sits on the bank under leaning trees. In the middle distance a delicate iron footbridge crosses the water, with people standing on it. The overall style is early‑20th‑century hand‑coloured photography. French text is printed along the top and publisher information along the right edge.
